The D-Mail chain shifts worldlines: beta (Mayuri dies) to alpha (Kurisu dies, SERN dystopia). Each shift rewrites the single world; bodies do not travel - only his memory crosses. The 1% barrier separates attractor fields; reaching divergence >1% lands the Steins Gate worldline where both survive."}, {"id": "allocation", "title": "Fixture allocations", "kind": "test_fixture", "text": "Worldlines modeled as revisions: rBETA (original), rALPHA (post-D-Mail attractor field alpha), rSTEINS (divergence 1.048596).
